description: Use when an agent must screen many wallets at once (payouts, counterparty lists) against OFAC SDN wallet addresses. Input: addresses (1-50, comma-separated, mixed chains) or POST JSON {addresses:[...]}. Output: per address listed yes/no, detected chains, SDN entity, programs; summary counts; list date. Unknown formats refused before payment. Not a legal determination. Example: ?addresses=0x098B716B8Aaf21512996dC57EB0615e2383E2f96,TNiq9AXBp9EjUqhDhrwrfvAA8U3GUQZH81 Price: $0.01 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

addresses.description: 1-50 crypto addresses, comma-separated (0x… EVM, BTC, TRX, SOL, LTC, XMR, …)

name: sanctions_address_batch
title: OFAC wallet screening in bulk: up to 50 crypto addresses (EVM, BTC, TRX, SOL, …) in one call
